data.exact_reserve_text: An overall improvement of GBP 3.1 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year. This is due to improvements of GBP 4.3 million on property reinsurance and GBP 0.3 million on marine reinsurance partially offset by a deterioration of GBP 1.5 million on casualty reinsurance.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6134 experienced an overall improvement of GBP 3.1 million on prior years' provisions in 2022. This favorable development was driven by improvements of GBP 4.3 million on property reinsurance and GBP 0.3 million on marine reinsurance, partially offset by a deterioration of GBP 1.5 million on casualty reinsurance. The syndicate's gross and net liabilities are identical, indicating this is a gross movement.

data.data_quality_notes: The claims development table on page 13 is distorted by the reassumption of 2018 year of account liabilities as part of the 2020 quota share agreement, making it unreliable for calculating prior year development. The narrative on page 8 is used as the primary source for prior year development. Gross and Net claims outstanding are identical for this syndicate, implying no reinsurers' share for claims outstanding, thus the 'overall improvement' figure is considered gross.
